cohort: 200 women undergoing vaginal trial delivery, randomly assigned to an observation group (100 women) or a control group (100 women).
finding: For women undergoing vaginal trial delivery, a combination of AIDET communication and delivery rehearsal can relieve prenatal anxiety, enhance delivery efficiency, shorten labor duration, and somewhat improve delivery outcomes.
mod_finding: The observation group had higher rates of natural delivery, cesarean delivery, vaginal delivery, and neonatal asphyxia compared to the control group.
